title: How the LLM Wiki works
kicker: Lecture 3  ·  The LLM Wiki from scratch
note: text = subtitles; say = spelled for the voice. Numbers: experiments/logs (wiki_build.json, wiki_query_chains.json Q-EMMA, wiki_update.json, wiki_lint.json) and ledgerline/ledgerline/wiki_v4 (the real pages and links).

blocks.text: RAG goes back to the raw documents for every question. Andrej Karpathy proposed another way, an LLM Wiki: the model reads every source once, and writes what it learns into a wiki it keeps up to date.
blocks.say: RAG goes back to the raw documents for every question. Andrej Karpathy proposed another way, an L L M wiki: the model reads every source once, and writes what it learns into a wiki it keeps up to date.

blocks.text: Three layers: the raw sources, 693 files, never edited; the wiki, markdown pages the model owns; and the schema, AGENTS.md, the rules for every page.
blocks.say: Three layers: the raw sources, six hundred and ninety-three files, never edited; the wiki, markdown pages the model owns; and the schema, agents dot M D, the rules for every page.

blocks.text: First, ingest. The model reads the sources in 1,067 parts, takes out each fact with its quote and location, and writes it onto a page: one per supplier, policy, error code or screen. 683 pages, 4,035 links, and a line in log.md for each ingest.
blocks.say: First, ingest. The model reads the sources in one thousand and sixty-seven parts, takes out each fact with its quote and location, and writes it onto a page: one per supplier, policy, error code or screen. Six hundred and eighty-three pages, four thousand and thirty-five links, and a line in log dot M D for each ingest.

blocks.text: Each page is shaped like a Wikipedia article: a lead, an infobox, sections, links, and references to the exact source. Brightcell Energy: a prospective supplier in Lyon, not in the supplier master, its UN 38.3 report due in December.
blocks.say: Each page is shaped like a Wikipedia article: a lead, an infobox, sections, links, and references to the exact source. Brightcell Energy: a prospective supplier in Lyon, not in the supplier master, its U N thirty-eight point three report due in December.

blocks.text: Emma asks: can I buy the battery packs from Brightcell? They quote £104. The model reads index.md, the table of contents, and opens three pages: Brightcell, the Supplier Policy, and the procedure for quotations.
blocks.say: Emma asks: can I buy the battery packs from Brightcell? They quote a hundred and four pounds. The model reads index dot M D, the table of contents, and opens three pages: Brightcell, the Supplier Policy, and the procedure for quotations.

blocks.text: The answer: no, not today. Brightcell is not in the supplier master, and battery suppliers need a valid UN 38.3 certificate; price alone never decides. Each claim cites a page, and the pages cite 33 places in the sources.
blocks.say: The answer: no, not today. Brightcell is not in the supplier master, and battery suppliers need a valid U N thirty-eight point three certificate; price alone never decides. Each claim cites a page, and the pages cite thirty-three places in the sources.

blocks.text: A good answer is not thrown away. It is filed back as a new page with 16 references, so the next person who asks finds it in one step.
blocks.say: A good answer is not thrown away. It is filed back as a new page with sixteen references, so the next person who asks finds it in one step.

blocks.text: When a new document arrives, only the pages it touches change: patch note P6 updated four pages and created three, in 40 seconds, for 15 cents.
blocks.say: When a new document arrives, only the pages it touches change: patch note P six updated four pages and created three, in forty seconds, for fifteen cents.

blocks.text: And lint checks the whole wiki for superseded copies, contradictions and broken links. It found 31 of the 40 problems we planted.
blocks.say: And lint checks the whole wiki for superseded copies, contradictions and broken links. It found thirty-one of the forty problems we planted.

blocks.text: RAG reads the raw pile at every question. The wiki reads it once, and keeps what it learned as linked pages. Which should Ask Northbridge use? We race them.
blocks.say: RAG reads the raw pile at every question. The wiki reads it once, and keeps what it learned as linked pages. Which should Ask Northbridge use? We race them.
